name: devarena-arena
about: The Dev Arena for a human: python -m gamelab run devarena/arena --mode watch. A lab copy of the game (the fixture's ranger, never the user's saves or install) boots onto dark_citadel floor 13 with the floor cleared and ranger_nature/mid applied, then holds until the game window is closed (up to 4 h). F1 dock, F2 A/B, F3 fresh golem, F4 golem room (mods/devarena/README.md). Edits go through the dock; [Relaunch] is not available here (the runner's relaunch step is a scripted run's), so a REFS edit waits for the next session.

steps.name: play until the window is closed
